newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds mixed, no reaction to U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds mixed, no reaction to U.S. data.

text.p: Argentine bonds were narrowly mixed late morning Wednesday confounding some players who had expected gains along with U.S. Treasuries after the release of market friendly U.S. producer price figures.
"I was fairly surprised that the market did not rise on the figure," said one trader at a local bank. "I suppose people are waiting for the consumer prices and the Federal Reserve."
U.S. producer prices fell an unexpected 0.6 percent in April. U.S. consumer prices are due for release Thursday and the policy-setting Federal Open Market Committee meets May 20.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 was flat at 92-3/8, while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 4 due 2002 was up $0.15 at 115.40.
Another trader said the "market is very quiet," with inter-bank activity dominating.
